answer_text:
Here is a roundup of some of the **best stocks to buy in June 2026**, according to analysts and major financial outlets:

---

## 📈 Top Stocks to Buy Now – June 2026

### 1. 🛒 **MercadoLibre (MELI)**
MercadoLibre is often referred to as the "Amazon of Latin America," operating an e-commerce marketplace with a dominant presence in some of the region's most populous nations, including Brazil and Argentina. The marketplace saw $19 billion in merchandise volume in Q1 2026, up 42% from the same quarter in 2025.

---

### 2. 🏠 **Airbnb (ABNB)**
In Q1 2026, more than 156 million nights and experiences were booked on Airbnb's platform. Airbnb is not only massive and growing quickly, but also highly profitable — generating $4.5 billion in free cash flow and achieving a 36% FCF margin over the past 12 months. Looking forward, Airbnb has $12.1 billion in cash and short-term investments on its balance sheet and still has a massive growth opportunity, with its overall market opportunity estimated to be in the trillions of dollars.

---

### 3. 🚗 **Uber (UBER)**
Uber continues to benefit from steady demand in both ride-hailing and delivery. DA Davidson analyst Tom White maintained a Buy rating and $107 target on Uber stock. Analysts have a Strong Buy consensus rating on Uber stock based on 27 Buys and two Holds, with an average price target of $105.96, implying ~43% upside potential.

---

### 4. ⚡ **Vistra Corp. (VST)**
Vistra is a major U.S. power producer benefiting from rising electricity demand tied to data centers, AI, and electrification. It has been expanding its clean energy and battery storage assets while keeping steady cash flow from its traditional power fleet. Jefferies analyst Julien Dumoulin Smith reiterated a Buy rating and $212 target on Vistra stock, saying the stock now looks cheap after a 35% drop since late 2025.

---

### 5. ✈️ **Vertical Aerospace (EVTL)**
Vertical Aerospace is working on its VX4 aircraft, which aims to offer quiet, zero-emission urban flights. It is making progress on testing, certification, and partnerships with airlines and travel operators. While still years from full commercial service, analysts believe EVTL offers long-term upside if electric aviation scales the way many expect. The average EVTL stock price target implies upside potential of ~350%.

---

### 6. 📡 **Vishay Precision Group (VPG)**
Vishay Precision Group's precision measurement and sensing technologies business is booming as it rides long-term megatrends across semiconductor equipment, data centers, avionics, military and space, and beyond. Its first-quarter bookings jumped 25.5% sequentially to $102.1 million, and Vishay Precision is projected to grow its adjusted earnings by 100% in 2026 to $0.98 a share.

---

## 🌍 Market Context

The stock market has been volatile so far in 2026 due to the Iran conflict, tariff uncertainty, and fears of a weakening economy. Although the S&P 500 is close to an all-time high, many stocks look extremely attractive for long-term investors to consider buying.
